title: Choose a mock return value
summary: A mock can return a chosen value so the code under test has predictable input.
introduction: A mock can return a chosen value so the code under test has predictable input. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain choose a mock return value
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A mock can return a chosen value so the code under test has predictable input.

blocks.code:
import { test, expect, jest, beforeEach } from "@jest/globals";
test("reads a name", () => { const getName = jest.fn().mockReturnValue("Asha"); expect(getName()).toBe("Asha"); });
blocks.title: Choose a mock return value

blocks.text: The mock returns Asha every time in this example.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Choose Ben as the return value.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Keep the fake behaviour consistent with the real dependency's contract.
